why_it_matters.text: The first tricyclic antidepressant, sold as Tofranil, found in the 1950s during a search for a new antipsychotic. It is also used for bedwetting in children.

approval.basis: Marketed today (prescription) under ANDA 083745 in the Drugs@FDA data files.
